'''Volume 6''' is the sixth volume published {{pkmn|in France}} by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. As the chapters of the ''Black & White'' arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
